label: Job Description Writer
description: Draft professional, inclusive job descriptions with clear requirements, responsibilities, and competency profiles. Ensures alignment with role level, market standards, and anti-discrimination best practices.

guidedInputs.label: Role title
guidedInputs.description: The job title for the position you are hiring for.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Senior Compliance Officer, AML Analyst, Head of Risk

guidedInputs.label: Seniority level
guidedInputs.description: The level of the role in the organisational hierarchy.

guidedInputs.label: Department or function
guidedInputs.description: The team or department this role belongs to.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Compliance, Risk Management, Legal, Operations

guidedInputs.label: Industry
guidedInputs.description: The industry context affects required qualifications and terminology.

guidedInputs.label: Location and working arrangement
guidedInputs.description: Where the role is based and the working model.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Stockholm, hybrid (3 days office), fully remote within Nordics

guidedInputs.label: Key responsibilities (optional)
guidedInputs.description: If you already know the core responsibilities, list them here. Otherwise, Claude will suggest appropriate ones.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Lead the AML compliance programme, manage a team of 5 analysts, report to the Chief Compliance Officer

guidedInputs.label: Special requirements or notes
guidedInputs.description: Any specific certifications, languages, or other requirements.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Must hold CAMS certification, fluent in Swedish and English, experience with Norkom/Actimize preferred
